{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column
df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')

# Check for the six QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
total_qa_orders = df['revenue_clean'].eq(999999.99).sum()

# Check if any QA orders are in the loyal completed group
qa_in_loyal_completed = df.query("customer_segment == 'loyal' and status == 'completed' and revenue_clean == 999999.99")

print(f'Total QA orders in dataset: {total_qa_orders}')
print(f'QA orders in loyal completed group: {len(qa_in_loyal_completed)}')
print(f'First few rows of QA orders in loyal completed group:\n{qa_in_loyal_completed.head()}')"}
